title: Observables & Subscriptions
blurb: Understand lazy push streams, the Observable contract, Observers, and Subscriptions.

title: Creating Observables
blurb: Turn values, collections, DOM events, and clocks into streams.

title: Pipes & Transforming
blurb: Compose pure operators with pipe(), reshape values with map, inspect with tap, and accumulate with scan.

title: Filtering & Limiting
blurb: Select matching values and bound infinite streams with filter, take, takeWhile, and first.

title: Rate-Limiting & Time
blurb: Tame noisy streams with debounceTime, throttleTime, auditTime, sampleTime, and distinctUntilChanged.

title: Higher-Order & Flattening
blurb: Flatten streams of streams with switchMap, mergeMap, concatMap, exhaustMap, and the *All operators.

title: Combining & Joining
blurb: Combine latest state or join streams with combineLatest, withLatestFrom, merge, concat, zip, forkJoin, and race.

title: Subjects & Multicasting
blurb: Push values to many subscribers with Subjects and share executions with share and shareReplay.

title: Error Handling & Cleanup
blurb: Recover with catchError, retry with backoff, and guarantee teardown with takeUntil, finalize, and timeout.

title: Schedulers & Marble Testing
blurb: Control execution timing with schedulers and test streams deterministically with the TestScheduler.

title: Custom Operators & Batching
blurb: Build reusable operators and batch or partition streams with buffer, window, and groupBy.

title: Production Patterns & Interop
blurb: Prevent memory leaks, assemble typeahead and polling pipelines, and bridge to Promises and fetch.
